column1: # tools/doom/buffer-roles.tsv — buffer parameters that are roles, pinned per call site.
# tools/doom/buffer-names.rb requires every buffer argument to carry its
# callee parameter's name. A parameter here names a role rather than a field;
# each row pins ONE call site (the calling definition and the call's place
# among its calls to that callee) to the one argument it must pass there, so a
# swap between two sites is refused like any other misnaming.
